title: The Crane and the Crab
summary: An old bird by the water struggles for food and seeks help from a small friend.
coverScene: A clever crab sitting by the water looks at a large crane standing near the blue sea.

sentences.text: Beside the translucent expanse of a tranquil woodland pool, a solitary crane had spent long decades mastering the quiet art of the hunt.
Every single day of its enduring life had been dedicated to capturing the shimmering fish that populated the shaded water.
However, the relentless passing of seasons had finally claimed the bird's once formidable speed and agility.
Age had rendered the daily pursuit of sustenance an exhausting and nearly impossible endeavor.
Realizing that brute force could no longer secure its meals, the cunning predator recognized the necessity of a calculated deception.
Standing motionless at the water's edge, the crane adopted a posture of profound melancholy and despair.
It pulled its long neck into its grey feathers and allowed a single, brilliant drop of moisture to cling to its beak.
Soon enough, a little crab who lived among the reeds approached the imposing bird with hesitant caution.
Moved by curiosity and growing dread, the small creature inquired why the grand crane appeared so utterly desolate.
In response, the bird sighed heavily, projecting an air of manufactured tragedy and unbearable sorrow.
The crane wove a meticulous web of fabrication concerning an impending catastrophe that threatened the entire aquatic community.
With trembling grace, the bird claimed to have overheard men discussing their plans to drain the pool entirely.
These merciless humans, the crane insisted, would soon arrive with massive nets to capture every single fish and creature dwelling within the basin.
The listening crab felt a cold wave of panic wash over its fragile shell as the horrifying scenario unfolded.
Overwhelmed by distress, the small animal pleaded to know if any sanctuary existed far away from this doomed habitat.
Seizing the moment, the crane raised its long beak and pointed toward the distant, undulating line of green hills.
It described a magnificent, hidden lake where the water remained forever cool and abundant with untouched life.
With an air of supreme benevolence, the bird offered to transport the inhabitants one by one to this utopian refuge.
Relief swept through the trusting crab, blinding it to the subtle glint of calculation in the bird's unblinking eyes.
Never once did the innocent creature suspect that the promised sanctuary was merely a cruel illusion designed to feed a starving monster.
Day after day, the crane dutifully carried fish away in its long beak under the guise of relocation.
Instead of guiding them toward any distant paradise, the deceitful animal merely flew to a jagged pile of grey boulders.
There, untouched by pity, the bird consumed every single passenger before they could even comprehend the betrayal.
The bones of the trusting victims accumulated in a grim heap beneath the rocks, whitening under the relentless sun.
Oblivious to the slaughter, the remaining inhabitants of the pool waited eagerly for their turn to be saved.
Eventually, the appointed hour arrived for the little crab to take the fateful journey toward the promised lake.
Climbing carefully upon the crane's broad back, the small animal settled in preparation for the long flight.
The bird launched itself into the azure sky, carrying its passenger high above the familiar trees and winding rivers.
Below them, the landscape stretched out in a vast, indifferent tapestry of green fields and distant blue shadows.
As they soared over a desolate ridge of stone, the crab peered downward and noticed something entirely unexpected.
Scattered across the grey earth below lay the glistening white skeletons of countless fish from the pool.
The terrifying truth crystallized in the crab's mind with the blinding clarity of a sudden lightning strike.
There was no secret lake, and there was no salvation; the benevolent guide was nothing more than a ruthless executioner.
A surge of righteous fury replaced the initial wave of shock within the small creature's heart.
Without a moment of hesitation, the intelligent animal resolved that it would not become another nameless victim.
Gathering all its courage and physical strength, the crab clamped its powerful claws around the crane's slender neck.
It tightened its grip with an iron determination, anchoring itself firmly against the rushing wind of the high altitude.
The crane gasped in sudden terror as the sharp shell pressed cruelly against its vulnerable throat.
Unable to breathe properly or maintain its steady flight, the massive bird began to spiral downward in a panic.
Desperate for air, the choking creature twisted wildly through the sky, but the stubborn crab refused to loosen its hold.
They crashed heavily onto the very ground from which their deceitful journey had begun weeks before.
Even as the dust settled around them, the quick-witted crab maintained its unyielding grip on the treacherous bird's neck.
The wicked crane realized that its life hung entirely by a thread held in the claws of its intended victim.
Squeezing tighter still, the small animal forced the trembling bird to utter a solemn promise of absolute surrender.
Only after receiving a guarantee of safe conduct did the victorious crab finally release its fierce embrace.
Released from the near-fatal grasp, the chastened bird fled the region entirely, never to return to the tranquil pool.
From that remarkable day forward, the clever crab lived safely and happily among the familiar reeds and cool water.
Every single fish that remained in the basin could now swim without fear, knowing the terrible threat was gone forever.
A profound sense of peace settled over the aquatic community, and the animals celebrated their hard-won freedom.
Under the bright, warm sun, they gathered to rejoice in a newfound security that would endure for many seasons.
They never forgot the great danger that had once threatened to destroy their entire community and way of life.
Should any new problem ever arise in the future, the creatures knew they would stand together to solve it.
Fear no longer ruled their days, replaced instead by a quiet strength born from unity and shared experience.
Life by the clear pool blossomed into something truly wonderful, filled with the simple joy of each passing afternoon.
Every single morning brought new light and happiness to the animals who had learned the true value of vigilance.
